description: Where builds on GitHub stand for this app, and what's next: whether GitHub is connected to Ploa, the repository, folder (and any platform's own folder) and release branch linked, Ploa's workflow on that branch (current, older, missing; whether it still builds), each platform's build state with its reason (the same the dashboard's Build button shows), where iOS builds (the person's Mac or GitHub's Macs), build files a build would miss, and GitHub minutes. Ends with the next steps, each marked for the person (with its link) or for you. Read-only.
